text:
pd-bot: PagerDuty page triggered: HIGH - az3-serving-degrade. Incident ID: INC-20260315-3421. Link: <https://pagerduty.company/INC-20260315-3421|view>
incident-bot: Automated alert from runtime-healthcheck: sustained increase in 5xx rate and p95 latency for hosted inference endpoints in az3. error_rate 7.8% -> 18% over 3m; p95 240ms -> 980ms. Affected model groups: rwd-small-v1, open-7b-quant.
olivia_oncall: acked via PD. Investigating now. @mike_sre can you grab logs and check autoscaler?
mike_sre: on it. seeing mass KV cache evictions across shards (approx 4k/s). autoscaler requests hitting quota errors, getting 429 from infra API when provisioning. also noticing backlog in batch-queue processors.
rachel_eng: batch queuing backlog confirms. routing shows ~30% requests auto-diverting off az3 already. some tenants seeing increased 429/5xx. can we proactively reroute more traffic while we fix nodes?
tian_eng_ml: model shard CPU hot on az3-nn-7 and nn-9; network RTT to kv-store nodes in same AZ spiking, could be transient fabric issue or NIC degradation.
sam_prod: Customer impact: CS reporting more tickets, mostly timeouts and model errors. Early estimate ~12% of EU-hosted requests affected. No data loss reported.
incident-bot: Running mitigation policy 'az-degrade-rapid-fallback' in 2m unless aborted. To abort: run /run-policy abort 6767000000
olivia_oncall: execute the fallback. prioritize reducing customer latency.
mike_sre: executing fallback now.
```bash
infra-cli fallback activate --region az3 --policy az-degrade-rapid-fallback --reason "KV cache evictions + autoscaler stuck"
```
incident-bot: Fallback started: rerouting 55% of incoming traffic off az3 to az2, az4. Routing map applied, propagation in progress.
rachel_eng: I've pushed a patch to increase KV cache max size on hot nodes and initiated a rolling restart on nn-7 only. watching for crash loops.
tian_eng_ml: diverted traffic shows immediate improvement for those flows: p95 ~340ms, error_rate down to ~5.2% on diverted requests. non-diverted requests still elevated.
mike_sre: escalated to @infra-team: autoscaler logs show rate-limiting when calling compute API to create instances (429). need quota bump or retry throttling fix.
sam_prod: @olivia_oncall please craft a short customer-facing note: impact, mitigation, ETA. CS needs something to send out.
olivia_oncall: Draft: "We are aware of degraded inference performance in AZ3 affecting a subset of hosted customers. We have rerouted traffic and are applying fixes; there is no data loss. We'll provide an update in 15 minutes." Thoughts? :thumbsup:
pd-bot: PD: Incident assigned to olivia_oncall. Reminder scheduled in 10m.
rachel_eng: During the restart sequence one node hit a crashloop due to old CUDA driver mismatch (nn-9). pausing further restarts until we confirm driver image consistency.
mike_sre: workaround: cordon nn-9 and migrate shards off it. Command: 
```bash
kubectl cordon nn-9 && kubectl drain nn-9 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
incident-bot: Recommended handoff at T+28m to next oncall if still active: @mike_sre for follow-up operations.
olivia_oncall: I'll monitor and handoff if not fully resolved. next update in 12 minutes.
tian_eng_ml: enabling aggressive local KV caching (ttl 10s) at router level to reduce remote KV fetches as a short-term mitigation.
rachel_eng: patch applied. eviction rate dropping to ~600/s from 4k/s. CPU hotspots cooling.
sam_prod: CS update: improvements noted; ticket surge stabilized. current affected request estimate down to ~2%.
mike_sre: marking as mitigated for now but not resolved. still waiting on infra quota to allow autoscaler to scale back to normal and on ops to fix nn-9 driver.
incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE: MITIGATED - traffic diverted off az3, problematic node cordoned, rolling fix in progress. auto-check scheduled in 10m.
olivia_oncall: thanks all. updating PD status and posting customer note. planning handoff to @mike_sre at 00:45 UTC unless resolved earlier.
pd-bot: PD: priority lowered to P2 and note appended.
rachel_eng: action items captured: 1) infra team to resolve autoscaler quota / API rate-limit; 2) ops to reconcile driver image versions and patch nn-9; 3) postmortem to analyze KV eviction pattern and routing thresholds. I'll open the incident doc and assign owners.
olivia_oncall: handing off to @mike_sre for overnight watch. thanks everyone for fast work. :heart:
